_note: Reconstructed from the challenge brief. Drop the official reference.json here to override — the loader reads this file at seed time and the API validates against it at runtime.

conventions.trailer_season_note: Season 0 is reserved for trailers. It is never rendered as a normal season in the viewer UI.
conventions.content_group_note: Episodes sharing a content_group are language variants of the same episode. They collapse into a single catalogue entry that lists its available languages.
